items.title: 68357_Jimmy Maxwell oral history interview
items.q: I guess everybody knows that Zoot does take a drink once in a while and at that time, so did Phil Woods.

ctx.x: you think of any tours or anything, some bands that might have given you a good laughs? When you went to Russia with Benny Goodman, you were on that first tour?

Yeah, that was pretty funny. You know, you don't like to tell tales out of school but I guess everybody knows that Zoot does take a drink once in a while and at that time, so did Phil Woods. And these guys were bombed from the start to the finish. And they drank the Russian wine and the Russians were sitting there looking at them like they're something from Mars, you know. But they secretly -- they did not like Benny, they hated him. They would spit when you mentioned his name because he gave them a hard time…

And Zoot was taking photographs all through the Soviet Union and all of a sudden we realized nobody ever saw him put film in the camera. And Phil said, 'Man, what are you taking all those pictures for? You're so goddamned drunk you don't know where you are.' And Zoot said, 'That's why I'm taking them, man, when I get home I'll look at the pictures and know where I was.'
